title: 현충시설의 지정ㆍ관리 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs ( Memorial Facilities Policy Division ), 044-202-5572

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「현충시설의 지정ㆍ관리 등에 관한 규정」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Regulations on the Designation and Management, etc. of Memorial Facilities” and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(관리번호) 「국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률」 제74조의2에 따라 지정된 현충시설에 대해서는 별표에 따라 관리번호를 부여하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Management Number) A management number shall be assigned to memorial facilities designated pursuant to Article 74-2 of the Act on the Treatment and Support of Persons of National Merit, etc., in accordance with the attached table.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(현충시설 관리대장의 작성ㆍ관리 등) ① 지방보훈청장, 보훈지청장 또는 제주특별자치도지사는 별지 제1호서식의 현충시설 관리대장을 갖추어 두어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Preparation and Management of Memorial Facilities Management Register, etc.) ① The head of a regional Veterans Affairs office, the head of a branch office of Veterans Affairs, or the Governor of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province shall keep a memorial facilities management register in the form of Annex No. 1.

rows.source_ko: ② 지방보훈청장, 보훈지청장 또는 제주특별자치도지사는 다음 각 호의 경우에는 지체 없이 별지 제1호서식의 현충시설 관리대장에 그 사실을 기록하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a regional Veterans Affairs office, the head of a branch office of Veterans Affairs, or the Governor of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province shall record the fact without delay in the Memorial Facilities Management Register in the form of Annex 1 in any of the following cases .

rows.source_ko: 1. 현충시설을 지정하거나 그 지정을 해제한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where a national memorial facility is designated or its designation is revoked
2. Cases where the manager of a memorial facility is designated or changed

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항의 현충시설 관리대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 있는 경우를 제외하고는 전자적 방법으로 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The register of memorial facilities referred to in Paragraph 1 shall be prepared and managed by electronic means, except in cases where there are special reasons making electronic processing impossible.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(실태조사계획) 국가보훈부장관은 매년 현충시설에 대한 실태조사계획을 수립하여 그 계획에 따라 지방보훈청장, 보훈지청장 또는 제주특별자치도지사로 하여금 실태조사를 하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Plan for Fact-finding Survey) The Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs shall formulate a plan for a fact-finding survey of national memorial facilities annually and, in accordance with said plan, have the heads of regional offices of patriotism and veterans affairs, branch offices of patriotism and veterans affairs, or the Governor of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province conduct the fact-finding survey. <Amended June 5, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(지정요청 및 지정의 서식) ① 「현충시설의 지정ㆍ관리 등에 관한 규정」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제4조제1항에 따라 현충시설의 지정을 요청하려는 자는 별지 제2호서식의 현충시설 지정요청서(전자문서로 된 요청서를 포함한다)에 해당 시설의 사진 1장과 시설의 건립취지 및 규모 등을 적은 자료를 첨부하여 관할 지방보훈청장, 보훈지청장 또는 제주특별자치도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Request for Designation and Form for Designation) ① A person who intends to request the designation of a memorial facility pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the “Regulations on the Designation and Management, etc. of Memorial Facilities” (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit a request for designation of a memorial facility in the form of Annex 2 (including a request in the form of an electronic document) to the competent head of the regional office of veterans affairs, the head of the branch office of veterans affairs, or the Governor of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, attaching one photograph of the facility and materials stating the purpose of construction and scale of the facility.

rows.source_ko: ② 국가보훈부장관은 현충시설을 지정하였을 때에는 별지 제3호서식의 현충시설 지정서를 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs has designated a National Memorial Facility, he or she shall issue a Certificate of Designation of National Memorial Facility in the form of Annex 3. <Amended June 5, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(고시 및 통지의 내용) ① 지방보훈청장, 보훈지청장 또는 제주특별자치도지사는 영 제10조에 따라 현충시설의 지정을 관보에 고시하거나 통지하는 경우에는 그 시설의 명칭ㆍ관리번호ㆍ소재지ㆍ관리자 및 지정시기를 명확히 밝혀야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Contents of Notice and Notification) ① When the head of a regional office of veterans affairs, the head of a branch office of veterans affairs, or the Governor of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province publishes the designation of a memorial facility in the Official Gazette or provides notification pursuant to Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall clearly state the name, management number, location, manager, and time of designation of the facility.

rows.source_ko: ② 지방보훈청장, 보훈지청장 또는 제주특별자치도지사는 영 제10조에 따라 현충시설 지정의 해제를 관보에 고시하거나 통지하는 경우에는 시설의 명칭ㆍ관리번호ㆍ소재지와 해제 사유 및 시기를 명확히 밝혀야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the head of a regional office of veterans affairs, the head of a branch office of veterans affairs, or the Governor of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province publishes a notice in the Official Gazette or provides notification regarding the revocation of the designation of a memorial facility pursuant to Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree, they must clearly state the name, management number, and location of the facility, as well as the reason and timing of the revocation.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(실태조사 공무원의 증표) 영 제13조제2항에 따른 증표는 실태조사를 하는 공무원의 공무원증으로 갈음한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Identification for Public Officials Conducting Fact-Finding Surveys) The identification under Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be replaced by the public official identification card of the public official conducting the fact-finding survey.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 12, 2014]
ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 732, Mar. 30, 2002>

rows.text_en: ⑨ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Designation and Management of Memorial Facilities, etc. is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 및 제5조제2항 중 “국가보훈처장”을 각각 “국가보훈부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 4 and Article 5, Paragraph 2, “Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs” shall be changed to “Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제2호서식 뒤쪽의 처리절차란 중 “국가보훈처(나라사랑정책과)”를 “국가보훈부(현충시설관리과)”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the processing procedure section on the back of Form No. 2, “Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs (Patriotism Policy Division)” shall be changed to “Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs (Memorial Facilities Management Division).”
In Form No. 3 of the Attached Appendix, “Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs” shall be changed to “Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs”.
